LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/joshuaalimi
Area: North London

Profile Summary
Biomedical Science graduate with a strong foundation in bioinformatics, data analytics, and programming,
passionate about leveraging technology to drive insights in biotech and healthcare technology.
Proficient in Python, Java, SQL, Tableau, and Power BI, with expertise in data manipulation, trend analysis,
and statistical modelling. Experience in software sales and IT support enhances my ability to translate
complex data into actionable business insights. Seeking to apply my data analytics and programming skills in
a technology-driven environment to solve real-world challenges.

Education
BSc (Hons) Biomedical Science – 2:1( Birmingham City University | July 2024)
Relevant Modules:
• Research Methods | Clinical Biochemistry | Medical Biotechnology
• Medical Genetics | Biochemistry | Physiology | Anatomy & Healthcare Systems
Final Year Project:
• Conducted a comparative analysis of DNA methylation sites using bioinformatics R packages,
identifying differential methylation patterns and their biological implications.
A Levels – Biology, Psychology, Computer Science(Alec Reed Academy | 2017 – 2019)

Computer science project- During my A-Level Computer Science studies, I built a website that helped
basketball players find nearby courts, using Python, SQL databases, and data analytics. The platform
stored and analysed court availability and player activity, making access more efficient. This project
strengthened my skills in programming, data management, and problem-solving, which I aim to apply in
data science and analytics.

Data Acquisition Quality Specialist
MHRA–  | Feb 2025 - Current
• Ensured the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of acquired data with regulatory and legislative
standards.

units.
• Utilized Microsoft Excel (including advanced functions, pivot tables, and data validation) to
organize, analyse, and report on data.
• Queried and managed databases using SQL to extract, audit, and monitor data quality.
• Developed and maintained data quality dashboards and reports to track performance against
KPIs.
• Collaborated cross-functionally with data engineers, analysts, and compliance teams to
implement data governance best practices.
• Participated in the design and refinement of data pipelines to enhance data acquisition
workflows.

Technical & Professional Experience
Data Analytics & IT Support – North London PC
1st / 2nd Line Support & Software Sales | Feb 2018 – 2021
• Managed large datasets, performed data manipulation and trend analysis to support business
decisions.
• Installed, configured, and maintained hardware/software systems; optimized network security.
• Developed SQL queries to extract and manage data efficiently.
• Utilized data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) to create insightful business reports.
• Led software sales, identifying customer needs and providing data-driven solutions.
• Managed the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals and account management.
• Built and maintained client relationships, driving retention and upsell opportunities.

Technical & Data Analytics Skills
• Programming & Data Analysis: Python, R, SQL, MATLAB
• Data Visualization & Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, Excel (Advanced)
• Statistical Modelling & Data Manipulation: Regression analysis, trend forecasting, anomaly
detection
• Database Management: SQL, relational databases
• Machine Learning (Basic): Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy
• Bioinformatics & Lab Techniques: PCR, ELISA, Western Blotting, Flow Cytometry, Microscopy
• IT & Cybersecurity: Network administration, ITIL principles, cloud computing

Soft Skills
• Strong numerical & analytical skills – adept at handling large datasets.
• Attention to detail – precise in data interpretation and reporting.
• Problem-solving & critical thinking – ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data.
• Communication & presentation skills – ability to convey findings clearly and concisely.
• Interpersonal & relationship management – liaising with stakeholders at all levels.
• Time management & organization – ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Understanding of data protection & compliance – ensuring adherence to industry regulations.
